genre.en: a beauty-magazine editorial close-up: skin and detail in soft directional light, clean and real, not retouched to plastic

s: a single close-up of a lash artist's tweezers lifting one lash fan toward a client's closed eye, the lash studio's wall painted terracotta-orange behind them, one hard window light from camera-left casting a crisp shadow of the tweezers across the eyelid

the lash bed with its pillow and tape strips, the lash tile and tweezers laid in a row on the artist's work trolley against a deep-teal wall, hard side light from the right throwing long sharp shadows of every tool

a client lying on the lash bed in a real studio room, eyes taped shut and lashes fully dressed, the wall behind them a muted tomato red, a hard spotlight from above-left drawing a clean shadow of the lash fans onto the cheek

the artist's gloved hands holding a lash fan under a gooseneck lamp at a worn wooden work desk against a mint-green wall, the lamp's hard beam from the upper right throwing a sharp shadow of the tweezers onto the tile

a close-up of a client's closed eye mid-application, one lash fan held by tweezers just above the lash line, the studio wall behind a saturated terracotta-orange, hard window light from camera-left casting a crisp shadow of the tweezers across the eyelid
the client lying on the lash bed with under-eye gel pads on and a full set of lashes visible, the wall behind a deep sea-blue, a hard lamp from above-right throwing a sharp lash shadow down the cheek
a macro of the finished lashes curling up from a closed eye, a mint-green studio wall behind, low hard light from the left throwing each lash's long thin shadow across the lid

the artist's hands isolating a single natural lash with fine tweezers in a real lash room, the wall a muted tomato red, a hard gooseneck-lamp beam from the right cutting a clear shadow of the tweezers over the eye pad

the lash tile of pre-made fans and the tweezers on the work trolley beside the lash bed, a deep-teal wall behind, hard side light from the left casting long sharp shadows of the tweezers and the glue cup

two pairs of hands, the instructor's guiding the learner's, over a mannequin eye in a real lash classroom, the wall a terracotta-orange, a hard lamp from above-right drawing crisp shadows of both tweezers onto the lash strip
